results.claim: [O'S] Theorem 1.1 (O'Sullivan, arXiv:2007.13582v2): RH iff J_{d,n}(X) is hyperbolic for all d>=1, n>=0, with J from (1.3) and gamma(m)=m!/(2m)!*xi^(2m)(1/2); plus the Notes claim that Farmer arXiv:2008.07206 says the same 'at title length' and is '[GOR+]'s reference [10]'.
results.paper_quote: "Theorem 1.1. The Riemann hypothesis is true if and only if J^{d,n}(X) is hyperbolic for all d>=1, n>=0."; (1.3) "J^{d,n}(X):=sum_{j=0}^{d} binom(d,j) gamma(n+j) X^j"; (1.2) "gamma(m):=m!/(2m)! xi^(2m)(1/2)". Farmer 2008.07206v2 title: "Jensen polynomials are not a plausible route to proving the Riemann Hypothesis" (abstract: "no justification ... not useful for attacking the Riemann Hypothesis"). GOR+ published Adv. Math. 397 (2022) 108186: "[10] D.W. Farmer, Jensen polynomials are not a viable route ... arXiv:2008.07206, 2020."
results.doc_quote: "**[O'S] Theorem 1.1.** *The Riemann hypothesis is true if and only if J_{d,n}(X) is hyperbolic for all d >= 1, n >= 0.*"; "[O'S] (1.3)"; Notes: "Farmer says so at title length (arXiv:2008.07206, cited by [GOR+] as their [10])".
results.notes: Read: arxiv.org/html/2007.13582v2 and arxiv.org/html/2008.07206v2 (both full text); GOR+ checked in the archive's published copy xi-horn/jensens-polynomials.pdf. Theorem 1.1 and (1.3) verbatim (doc's J_{d,n} vs paper's J^{d,n}: notation only); numbering identical in O'Sullivan v1 and v2; Status cites v2, matching the local zeros-jensens-polynomials.pdf. Farmer's title claim holds (v1 'viable', v2 'plausible'). GOR+ ref [10]=Farmer in the published version, but in arXiv:1910.01227v3 Farmer is [11] (DLMF is [10]); they cite him in Remark (2), not as their own conclusion. Minor: the doc's Corollary 3.2 paraphrase writes 'xi^(n)' where the paper says Theta^{(n)} (Theta(z)=xi(1/2+sqrt z)).
